contents: English video: FFV1, the decoded frames unchanged (yuv420p). Audio of every language: FLAC, the decoded samples unchanged (16-bit, native rate and channels). French and German video: not decoded here (the .rpl checksums and decoded-stream checksums identify it).

decoded_sha256.video: ffmpeg -i <file> -map 0:v:0 -fps_mode passthrough -c:v rawvideo -pix_fmt yuv420p -f hash -hash sha256 -
